response.original_title: Lost Keys of China: The Works of Tian Jinqin
response.overview: Lost Keys of China: The Works of Tian Jinqin chronicles the life of self-taught inventor Tian Jinqin, whose pioneering string-controlled electronic instruments drew inspiration from traditional Chinese music rather than Western keyboards. Through interviews and demonstrations of his creations, the film uncovers the story of an overlooked innovator whose lifelong curiosity extended far beyond music, revealing a legacy of ingenuity, resilience, and artistic vision.
